parameters.help_en:
The general switch type.
You can obtain this parameter from the SwitchId response parameter of the [ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~) and [ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~) operations
parameters.help_zh:
通用开关类型。
通过[ListClientUserDefineRules](~~ListClientUserDefineRules~~)、[ListSystemClientRules](~~ListSystemClientRules~~)接口的响应参数SwitchId可以获取该参数
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the switch takes effect by default. Valid values:

add: Takes effect by default for newly added servers.
del: Does not take effect by default for newly added servers
parameters.help_zh:
默认是否生效。取值：

add：新增主机默认生效。
del：新增主机默认不生效
parameters.name: target_default

parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
